ev.q: seven cVDPV2 emergences of nOPV2 origin from 61 paralytic cases and 39 environmental surveillance (sewage) samples were detected in six countries
cVDPV2 emergences occur after mOPV2 use at a rate of one emergence per 10 million mOPV2 doses administered
for nOPV2, this rate is approximately 10 times lower, at one emergence per 100 million doses
